admitted_claim: Original 96x32 quadrature preserved through reflected pairs; frozen empirical kernel and warm two-step integration acceptance passed on stored local evidence; optional native backend and target-local build/executor handoff ready.

findings.basis: Each pair has the same mu^2 kernel. fold_model checks exact actual mu antisymmetry, mu2/P2/weight symmetry and angular algebra, fixed contiguous float64 shapes, finite nonnegative weights/q2 and positive mass. Original paired weights are added once; 96 radial nodes and all 32 angular weights are retained.

C++ Sum implements Neumaier larger-magnitude correction and final s+c for each moment. Fixed operation order, fno-fast-math and ffp-contract=off protect compensation. ctypes signature matches three const double pointers, three doubles, output double pointer and int status. Per-call angle arrays have size 16; fixed loops consume 96x16 folded inputs.

Direct differentiation gives dx J0=-3J0-J1 and db J0=-2J2. LRS diagonal contraction is 2sD. With Sigma=sqrt(3)s/H and Pi=kappa_t D/(sqrt(3)H^2), work/(H^3/kappa_t)=2 Sigma Pi. Actual split normalization retains signed component sum and original dimensional conversion. Stored symbolic evidence agrees.

MRO is NativeGuard -> ExactMomentCache -> NativeMiss -> owner. Exact binary64 x,b keys and existing domain checks precede miss. Per-model bytes-backed copied arrays, original binding checks and added folded/angle metadata checks prevent accidental cache-source reassignment; fresh model state is retained.

Target build and execution remain future work.

limitations: Acceptance is the predeclared finite empirical envelope, not a global floating-point/transcendental bound.
Five two-step trajectories verify connection to the pinned warm solver; they do not replace the completed 64-step 729-case pilot or prove time/grid convergence.
No benchmark, measured speedup, full729 rerun or NCP target execution is admitted.
No non-LRS, tilted/odd distribution, full-EoR or full-Q^a claim.
Build receipts contain target-local metadata, so rebuilding can change backend namespace even for equivalent source; this is conservative checkpoint separation, not a physics failure.
Unit/integration executions are assessed through preserved logs, source and raw artifacts; reviewer performed no additional execution suites.
